items.description: This repository provides a Lean 4, mathlib-based formalization of the RoughBlocks result on m-rough numbers in short intervals near m². It exposes a stable Light facade (auditable API) proving main_theorem_ge_1e6 (LB m x ≥ 1 for m ≥ 10^6 and x ≤ 8), with no axioms beyond system ones (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound).
